title: Modernize VB6 Authentication System
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 authentication uses basic password masking and hardcoded database connections, exposing critical security vulnerabilities in banking application
risk_if_unaddressed: Customer financial data exposure, regulatory compliance violations, potential data breaches
suggested_approach: Implement modern authentication with encrypted connections, parameterized queries, and secure credential storage
success_criteria: Modern password hashing replaces basic masking

title: Secure Database Connection Layer
problem_statement: Legacy ADO connections use hardcoded paths and lack parameterization, creating SQL injection vulnerabilities
risk_if_unaddressed: SQL injection attacks, data corruption, unauthorized data access
suggested_approach: Replace hardcoded connections with configuration-based approach, implement parameterized queries, add connection pooling

title: Implement Comprehensive Agent Error Handling
problem_statement: Multi-agent orchestration lacks structured error handling and failure recovery mechanisms
risk_if_unaddressed: System instability, difficult debugging, cascading failures across agents
suggested_approach: Implement structured exception handling, circuit breaker patterns, and comprehensive logging across agent layer
success_criteria: Circuit breaker patterns for external dependencies

provenance.evidence: Complex agent interdependencies without clear error handling

title: Add Input Validation to VB6 Forms
problem_statement: VB6 forms lack input validation and proper error handling in event handlers
risk_if_unaddressed: Invalid data entry, application crashes, poor user experience
suggested_approach: Add input validation routines, implement proper error handling in event handlers, add user feedback mechanisms
success_criteria: Input validation on all form controls
Error handling in all event handlers

title: Implement State Store Health Monitoring
problem_statement: Recent Firestore/GCS fixes indicate potential instability in core state management system
risk_if_unaddressed: Agent coordination failures, data loss, system unavailability
suggested_approach: Implement health checks, monitoring dashboards, and failover mechanisms for state store dependencies
